crossRefs.note: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.
Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man, and don’t associate with one who harbors anger:
Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know…
Now therefore know and consider what you will do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his house…

translations.web: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
translations.bsb: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who does not control his temper.
translations.kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
translations.asv: He whose spirit is without restraint Is like a city that is broken down and without walls.
